page_title: NEW 1-2 FUL | Newcastle v Fulham 01/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+2' The referee has issued a yellow card to Bernd Leno (Fulham).
90+2' Lloyd Kelly (Newcastle Utd) latched on to a precise cross, but his bullet header missed the target. He should have done much better.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
88' Substitution. Issa Diop (Fulham) has come on for Adama Traore.
87' The referee allows time for a substitution. Lewis Hall will be replaced by Lloyd Kelly (Newcastle Utd).
87' Here is a change. Jacob Murphy is going off and Eddie Howe gives the last tactical orders to William Osula (Newcastle Utd).
87' Bruno Guimaraes will be replaced by Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd).
86' Newcastle have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
85' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) gets booked for the first time in this match.
82' 1 - 2 Andreas Pereira sends a cross in from the free kick. Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) wins the ball and smashes it into the bottom left corner, increasing the score to 1:2.
82' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
79' Substitution. Alex Iwobi did his best and is replaced by Ryan Sessegnon (Fulham).
78' A yellow card for a tackle by Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd). Chris Kavanagh doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
76' That looked a certain handball by Timothy Castagne (Fulham) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
74' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) smashes the ball against the crossbar! What a chance.
74' The attendance is 52173.
73' Substitution. Raul Jimenez walks off the pitch and Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) comes on as a substitute.
72' Marco Silva has decided to make a change. Andreas Pereira (Fulham) replaces Emile Smith Rowe.
70' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Fulham.
67' The corner is swung in but Fulham can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
64' Eddie Howe prepares a substitution. Joelinton is replaced by Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd).
64' The game has come to an end for Valentino Livramento. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd).
63' Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) heads the ball towards goal, but his effort is saved by the goalkeeper.
63' Now Newcastle have a corner.
61' 1 - 1 Goal! Antonee Robinson plays it to Raul Jimenez (Fulham), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Martin Dubravka. 1:1.
60' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) outjumped his marker after a well-taken corner, but his header goes wide of the target.
60' The referee signals a corner kick to Fulham.
58' A cross from a corner kick by Newcastle is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
57' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) has a shot blocked from inside the box. The ball goes out of play and Fulham have been awarded a corner kick.
56' The referee blows his whistle, Fulham are awarded a corner kick.
56' The linesman raises his flag. Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) is adjudged offside.
55' Adama Traore (Fulham) is penalised for a foul. Chris Kavanagh had a clear view and blows his whistle.
52' Adama Traore (Fulham) plays a through ball but overhits it.
49' Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Martin Dubravka makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
47' The linesman signals that Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' Today's referee Chris Kavanagh rightly decides to book Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) for his harsh tackle.
45+3' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
45+3' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
43' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
42' The game is interrupted now, Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
40' Great save! Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom left corner was brilliantly saved by Bernd Leno.
40' Fulham get a corner.
37' 1 - 0 Goal! Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) unleashes a first-time shot from inside the box and beats the goalkeeper inside the right post. 1:0.
35' It's like he was asking for a caution. Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) receives a yellow card.
35' It should have been a goal! Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) fires a rocket of a shot but it only hits the crossbar!
31' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles past the right post.
30' Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) had a golden opportunity. He volleyed from point blank range towards the middle of the goal, but Bernd Leno was alert and made an amazing save!
27' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) got the ball on the edge of the box and fired in a first-time shot on goal, but his effort floated well over the bar. High, wide and not at all handsome.
26' Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
20' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
20' Adama Traore (Fulham) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
18' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Newcastle, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
17' Caution goes to Joachim Andersen (Fulham).
15' Great touch by Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) as he latched on to a stunning crossfield cross, but he fails to find the target and sends the ball from long range well wide of the right post.
14' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Chris Kavanagh blows for a foul.
11' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Fulham comes to nothing.
10' Adama Traore (Fulham) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Fulham force a corner. They send men into the box.
10' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
6' A quickly taken corner by Newcastle.
4' A fine move culminates with a precision cross onto the head of Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) in the centre of the box. It's a good attempt but goes just over the bar.
4' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Alexander Isak, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
1' Flag up against Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Newcastle will have the kick-off.
Chris Kavanagh will supervise the game today.
